text: Pay: 1,580 euros gross per month, in 14 payments a year. Saturday shifts in peak season are paid at 1.5 times the normal rate.

Shifts rotate every week: the morning shift is 6:00 to 14:00 and the afternoon shift is 14:00 to 22:00, Monday to Friday. There are no night shifts. In peak season (November and December) some Saturdays are needed, and they are paid extra.

The warehouse is in the Getafe logistics park, in Madrid. Bus lines 441 and 442 stop at the entrance. There is free parking for cars and bikes. A free shuttle bus runs from Getafe Central station before each shift.
The contract is full time, 40 hours a week. It starts as a 6-month contract and becomes permanent after a good review.
Daily tasks: picking customer orders with a hand scanner, packing them, labeling parcels, and loading trucks. The work includes lifting boxes of up to 15 kg and standing most of the shift.
New operators get 2 weeks of paid training. Harbor Logistics pays for the forklift licence for operators who want it, after 3 months.
Safety boots, gloves, a high-visibility vest and the uniform are provided free of charge.
Holidays: 23 working days a year, plus public holidays. The warehouse closes on 25 December and 1 January.
Benefits: a canteen with a subsidized menu, free coffee and fruit, and a transport allowance of 40 euros per month.
No warehouse experience is required. Experience in teamwork, physical work, retail or hospitality is useful. A forklift licence is a plus, not a requirement.
Basic Spanish is enough for the job. Training and safety instructions are available in Spanish and English.
After this call: a 30-minute video interview with the warehouse manager, then a 1-hour visit to the warehouse. A decision comes within one week of the visit.
Overtime is voluntary and paid at 1.25 times the normal rate. It is offered mostly in peak season.
Each 8-hour shift has a 30-minute paid break.
